title: Isometric Instruction Manual — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Orient
scenes.purpose: Show parts A (socket up) and B (peg down) in the correct orientation in a fixed isometric view before any motion.
visuals: Manual page on stationary slate desk
Neutral cube A with dark socket
Accent-tinted cube B with blue peg hovering above A
Blue down arrow drawn along the z axis; head appears only when shaft completes

beats.development: Engagement axis fades in, the z-axis arrow draws, its head appears at 0.58 s.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Align + lock
scenes.purpose: B travels along its engagement axis, the peg enters the socket and the joint locks, then an assembled hold.
visuals: Peg exactly cut at A's top plane as it inserts
B returns from accent to neutral after locking

beats.development: B descends (power2.inOut); axis and arrow fade.
Joint locks: ring pulse, B turns neutral; assembled hold.

scenes.title: Connect
scenes.purpose: Next step revealed only after the lock: part C slides along the x axis so its tab enters A's side slot, completing the system.
visuals: C fades in at the right in the same orientation
x-axis arrow draws, head appears at 1.88 s
C slides along -x; tab exactly cut at A's +x face
Lock ring at slot, C returns to neutral

beats.development: Step tag switches to 3, C revealed, connect arrow draws.
C slides into A along the x axis.
Joint locks with ring pulse; check badge pops and caption appears; settled by 2.66 s and held to 3 s.

findings: Each step shows orientation/direction before motion, then locks before the next step appears.
Brisk 3 s preview: three operations with short holds.
justifiedHolds: 1.21–1.5 s assembled hold after first lock (style rule).
2.66–3.0 s final settled reading hold for caption.

notes: No reviewed preview recipes were listed in STYLE.json; the preview demonstrates the primary characteristic action (align two complementary parts, show orientation, lock, then reveal the next step).
